aboutPage.mediatorNote: Bhara's key feature is that we stay in the middle — you never have to deal with a stranger directly. We take the responsibility!
aboutPage.social: Stay in touch with us on social media
aboutPage.step1Desc: Upload your product with photos, a description and rental rates. We verify and approve each listing.
aboutPage.step2Desc: A renter sends a request. With your permission, we collect the product.
aboutPage.step3Desc: We hand the product to the renter and, when the time is up, inspect it and return it to you.
aboutPage.storyP1: Bhara's journey began in 2025, when our founders noticed a problem — the lack of a safe and trusted platform for renting in Bangladesh. In cities like Dhaka or Chattogram, where space is limited and prices are high, not everyone can afford or needs to buy everything.
aboutPage.storyP2: To build a platform where people can safely and easily rent out their used and unused belongings, and rent what they need at a low cost. We want to build a sharing economy that reduces consumerism and helps protect the environment.
aboutPage.storyP3: Through Bhara we are working to make renting simple, safe and enjoyable. We act as the intermediary so that trust and safety are guaranteed for both sides.
aboutPage.subtitle: Bhara is Bangladesh's first trusted rental marketplace where you can safely rent out your belongings or rent items from others.
aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.value1Desc: We believe safety matters most. That's why every rental is secured with identity verification, an agreement and a security deposit.
aboutPage.value2Desc: We stay fully transparent about all fees, terms and the compensation process. If you have questions, we're always ready to answer.
aboutPage.value3Desc: We act responsibly in every rental transaction, always protecting the interests of both the owner and the renter.
aboutPage.value4Desc: By supporting the rental economy we help protect the environment. Renting instead of buying ensures the best use of resources and reduces waste.

general.a1: Bhara is a rental marketplace where you can rent out your belongings or rent items from others.
general.a2: Anyone who owns something useful and wants to let others use it for a while, or anyone who needs something but doesn't want to buy it and would rather rent it temporarily.
general.title: General

misc.a1: No — both sides only ever deal with Bhara. This keeps everyone safe and preserves privacy.
misc.a2: You can update the photos, price or description, and we can highlight your listing as well.
misc.q1: Will I know the other party when renting?
misc.q2: What if nobody rents my product?

owners.a1: Good-quality photos of your product, a set rental price, any necessary terms, and a basic description.
owners.a2: You never hand anything to a stranger yourself. We act as the intermediary for the entire rental process. You rent your item out through us, and you get it back through us too.
owners.a3: That responsibility is entirely ours. Before any rental we sign a written agreement that clearly covers damage terms, late charges, and what steps we take if an item isn't returned. If anything happens to your item, we compensate you — it's not your worry.
owners.a4: Yes, you can. You can set a security deposit amount on your product. It is collected before the rental starts and returned if there are no issues.
owners.a5: You don't need to. We verify their identity, sign the agreement with them, and can take legal steps if needed. You only deal with us, and we ensure safety for both sides.
owners.a6: We are building a safe and transparent rental system where you can let others use your belongings without taking any risk. Your protection, compensation, and trust are our highest priorities.
owners.q1: What do I need to rent out my item?
owners.q2: I don't know anyone — how can I feel secure?
owners.q3: What if the renter damages my item, returns it late, or doesn't return it?
owners.q4: Can I ask for a security deposit?
owners.q5: How will I know who is renting my item?

payment.a1: Payments are made offline or via mobile payment. The Bhara platform doesn't process payments directly.
payment.a2: Owners may ask for a deposit on some products, which is refundable at the end of the rental.
payment.a3: Once the product is returned and everything checks out, the deposit is returned — usually offline or via mobile payment.
payment.q3: How do I get my money back?
payment.title: Payments & Deposits

process.a1: When a renter sends a request, we collect the product from the owner, inspect it, and deliver it to the renter. Late returns incur a fine, and Bhara takes responsibility for any damage.
process.a2: Yes — identity verification, a formal agreement, and a security deposit where needed.
process.a3: You will be liable for compensation. We make this clear in advance and include it in the agreement.
process.a4: Bhara arranges compensation in that case. We take a safety agreement, ID verification, and a deposit before the rental begins.
process.a5: Each listing states its late-fee policy, and late returns are charged accordingly.
